description: This file defines the SandboxNode class, a node in Twig's syntax tree responsible for managing sandbox security context during template rendering. The class includes methods for constructing the node and compiling it into executable PHP code that enables and disables sandboxing as needed.

classes.name: SandboxNode
classes.description: A node representing a sandbox context in Twig, responsible for temporarily enabling sandbox security during template rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SandboxNode with the given body node and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to handle sandbox enabling/disabling around the body node execution.
